item.description:
The biggest Lattix update yet

  • macOS 27 support
  • You can now restore your workspaces from the menubar or using a hotkey, without closing your windows.
  • Lattix can now create and delete Spaces automatically.
  • Multiple window support, we recommend to prevent them from quitting so that lattix can position them accurately
  • Capture and update workspace layouts from the menubar.
  • Simpler hotkey commands. You can now use two or more keys to create a hotkey.
  • Better HUD.
  • Memory consumption optimizations and fixes.
  • Workspace stop behaviours now apply to any Space.
  • Unlimited Space captures.
  • Share logs for easier error debugging.
  • Newly designed onboarding.
  • Added Automation permission for Space management.
